mapper.select: select distinct t1.id, t1.name, t1.product_id, t1.active_version from bm_process t1 join bm_process_relation t2 on t1.id = t2.relation_process_id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.process_id = #{processId}

SELECT DISTINCT t3.id FROM bm_process t1 JOIN bm_resource_permission t2 ON t1.id = t2.resource_id JOIN bm_process_version AS t3 ON t1.id = t3.process_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t3.is_deleted = 0 AND t3.action_state = 'approval' AND t2.dept_id IN
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT t1.id FROM bm_process t1 JOIN bm_resource_permission t2 ON t1.id = t2.resource_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.dept_id IN
#{item}

SELECT t2.id as material_id, t2.inner_packing_specification as innerPackingSpecification, t2.packing_specification as packingSpecification, t2.product_mark as productMark, t2.merge_code as productMergeCode, t2.`name` as productName, t1.id as processId FROM bm_process AS t1 JOIN bm_material AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 and t1.id in
#{processId}
